分帧清点达到预算后暂停；单次引擎调用无法中途打断。: Pauses census work when the frame budget is reached; a single engine call cannot be interrupted.
按需读取主线程、渲染线程、GPU与等待计时；有额外采样成本，默认关闭。缺失不会填: Reads main/render thread, GPU, and wait timings on demand. Adds sampling cost; off by default. Missing data is not replaced with zero.
用于计算可疑开销参考预算，不改变游戏限帧。: Calculates reference timing budgets; does not change the game frame cap.
同时超过倍数和最小变化量才记录突变。: Records a spike only when both ratio and minimum change thresholds are exceeded.

物品、刚体、网络条目变化的最小绝对数量。: Minimum absolute change in item, rigidbody, or network entry counts.
同一指标在此间隔内重复异常时合并记录。: Merges repeated anomalies for the same metric within this interval.
需要停止观察者自身的采样工作。: Stop the tracker’s own sampling work.
关闭后停止计时和对象清点，保留已有记录。: Stops timers and censuses while retaining recorded data.
分帧统计场景中的刚体和碰撞体。: Counts scene rigidbodies and colliders across frames.
需要区分清醒、休眠和仅启用模拟的物体。: Distinguish awake, sleeping, and merely simulated objects.
遍历场景树，按每帧预算暂停，不在一帧搜索全场。: Walks the scene tree within a per-frame budget instead of scanning the entire scene in one frame.
高于轻量跟踪；默认关闭，统计结果有时间范围: More costly than lightweight tracking; off by default, with census time ranges

需要进一步判断遗留副本的状态。: Investigate the state of leftover objects.
只检查正在模拟的清醒自由物品；无碰撞或向下运动不直接判为故障。: Checks only awake, simulated, unparented items. Missing collision or downward motion alone is not treated as a fault.
分开观察CPU、GPU和等待计时。: Observe CPU, GPU, and wait timings separately.
避免把等待或低帧直接归因于物理。: Avoid attributing waiting or low FPS directly to physics.
只连接准确的引擎计时器；结果可能延迟数帧，缺失明确显示。: Uses exact engine timers. Results may be delayed by several frames; unavailable data is shown explicitly.
有额外成本，默认关闭；不提供具体函数调用栈: Additional cost; off by default. Does not provide per-function call stacks
相对近期平稳基线上升，同时超过倍数与最小毫秒变化阈值。: Increased above the recent smoothed baseline, exceeding both ratio and minimum timing thresholds.
阶段读数突增；计时可能延迟若干帧，等待也不等于计算瓶颈。: Stage reading spiked. Timings may lag by several frames; waiting does not prove a computation bottleneck.
两次完整统计之间发生较大变化；是区间变化，不能确定生成/唤醒瞬间，也不能单凭数量: Large change between completed censuses. This is an interval change, not an exact spawn/wake time; counts alone cannot explain low FPS.
事实读数低于警戒；主动限帧或垂直同步也可能造成此结果。: Measured FPS is below the threshold; the frame cap or VSync may also cause this.
检测到人数变化，已触发物品补清点；检测有采样间隔，不等同精确断线时刻。: Player count changed and an item census was requested. Detection follows the sampling interval, not the exact disconnect time.
托管内存突变；可能与资源分配或回收有关，不等于GC耗时。: Managed memory changed sharply. Allocation or collection may be involved; this is not GC timing.
补步增多；渲染帧率下降本身就会使该比值升高，不表示物理耗时增加。: More catch-up steps. Lower rendering FPS alone raises this ratio; it does not indicate increased physics time.
本采样区间发生完整GC；没有GC计时，不能断言它造成了长帧。: A full GC occurred during this sample interval. Without GC timing, it cannot be identified as the cause of a long frame.
